S1 [P2 should-fix] Reject invalid resolved deduction amounts before subtracting. packages/core/src/state/itemResetExecutor.ts:489-504 and :640-647; packages/core/src/rules/validate.ts:383-385. Authority: olc5.13's charge-loss/resource-integrity contract and ADR 0020 deterministic arithmetic/state integrity. A parseable dice expression can produce a negative total, but deductionAmount returns it unchecked and Math.min(amount, remaining) makes deducted negative. Concrete stdin probe: clone the bundled base, change only the Disintegrate amount cell to "1d2-3", successfully validateRulesPack, install the Cube at face-1 with 36 charges, and invoke the real item_state_event tool. It returns ok:true, amount:-2, deducted:-2, remaining:38 and persists 38 charges. This does not depend on an unvalidated resolver. Sibling probe: a separately validated table-only add-on overriding the Cube table with numeric -7 returns ok:true and raises 36 to 43, since local deduction validation never runs for that add-on. The committed SRD rows themselves are positive; the defect is in the new admitted pack/stack input boundary. Owner: deduction executor/validation. Required repair: enforce a finite, non-negative integer deduction amount at the resolved execution boundary before any write, refusing invalid outcomes atomically; align validation with that domain without changing unrelated dice semantics. Permanent evidence should be a generalized charge-loss invariant over admitted numeric/dice amounts: deductions never increase remaining, and invalid amounts leave the full database unchanged. This is proportionate to persisted resource corruption. Material repair; required next state is repaired and reviewed before approval.

S2 [P2 should-fix] Require a uniquely resolved row in the effective campaign table. packages/core/src/state/itemResetExecutor.ts:465-486 and :562-568; packages/core/src/rules/validate.ts:322-368. Authority: olc5.13 acceptance explicitly requires a uniquely resolved table row and fail-closed ambiguous context. Pack validation checks duplicate keys only when an effect in THAT pack declares economyDeduction, whereas execution resolves the table from the full campaign stack and uses rows.find. Concrete stdin probe: retain the validated bundled base; create a separately validateRulesPack-accepted compatible add-on containing only table:cube-of-force-charges-lost, explicitly overriding rules:dnd5e-srd-5.1/table:cube-of-force-charges-lost, with rows [["Disintegrate","1"],["Disintegrate","12"]]. Bind both packs and invoke item_state_event on the real Cube. It succeeds, picks the first row, deducts 1 and persists remaining:35 instead of refusing the ambiguous event. Generic table validation allows those duplicate key cells, and the add-on has no deduction effect to trigger the new pack-wide check. Thus source-pack validation is not evidence about the effective table. Owner: resolved-table deduction boundary. Required repair: enforce the deduction table contract on the actual resolved table and require exactly one matching key before rolling/writing; retain atomic refusal for malformed/ambiguous effective tables. Permanent evidence should be a generalized resolved-stack invariant using independently validated base/add-on packs, including duplicate-key ordering and invalid-key siblings. A small parameterized test is proportionate; a new audit framework is unnecessary. Material repair; required next state is repaired and reviewed before approval.

Other scope/evidence: vendored SRD p.215 agrees with generated Cube predicate, both columns, all five row names/dice, duration and running-out residual. records.json changes only the explicit Cube contact economyDeduction. Stdin assertions exercised all 25 Cube face/row combinations with clamping, preserved timers and an unstarted state-entered cooldown anchor, and no writes to other tables; Rod DC30 likewise preserved a fixture timer/unstarted anchor. Eight full-database refusal checks passed (unknown/missing/case-mismatched row, unknown/ambiguous condition, absent RNG, mixed executable/opaque effects on a state-changing transition, and tableRow on Rod). Exhausted plus a separate printed runs-out event is the explicitly authorized DM residual, not an automatic depletion hook. Readiness independently remains 13 ready before/after with zero changed outcomes across 446 resolved item/variant/operation combinations; no shared hooks were promoted.
